about.intro: I'm Matin Jahi, a frontend developer with 4+ years of experience building fast, scalable, SEO-optimised web applications with Vue.js, Nuxt.js and TypeScript — with a strong focus on clean code, accessibility, and delightful motion.
about.careerSubtitle: From interactive 3D experiences to large-scale EdTech platforms
about.skillsSubtitle: The tools and disciplines I use to ship production-grade frontends
about.philosophySubtitle: The principles behind every line of code I write
about.ctaText: Open to freelance projects, collaborations, and full-time opportunities. Let's talk about your next idea.

highlights: Architected scalable features for an open-source Nuxt.js 4 / Vue.js 3 EdTech platform serving 600,000+ registered schools
Designed an AI-assisted quiz builder and school finder, driving a 25% increase in user session duration
Integrated Three.js-powered interactive educational content, contributing to a 15% increase in user retention
Redesigned routing architecture across 15+ core pages, cutting page load times by 35% and improving Core Web Vitals
Led end-to-end frontend architecture for a leading travel platform, launching 7 core homepage sections in 8 months
Built a reusable Vue.js 3 component library in a microservices environment, accelerating feature delivery by 40%
Introduced RxJS for async data flow, reducing race-condition bugs by 65% in real-time search features
Created an interactive 3D product visualisation feature with Three.js and Blender, boosting engagement by 30%
Built GSAP-driven scroll-triggered animation systems, improving perceived performance and Core Web Vitals by 20%
Owned a shared Vue.js component library applying WCAG 2.1 standards and SOLID principles

philosophy.title: Clean, Maintainable Code
philosophy.description: SOLID principles, rigorous code review ownership, and enforced quality standards. Code should read like it was written by one careful person.

philosophy.title: Performance First
philosophy.description: Core Web Vitals are a feature, not an afterthought. From routing architecture to animation budgets, every decision is measured against real user experience.

philosophy.title: Accessible by Default
philosophy.description: WCAG 2.1 standards, semantic HTML, and Section 508-compliant navigation patterns. The web works best when it works for everyone.

philosophy.title: Motion with Purpose
philosophy.description: GSAP timelines, Three.js scenes, and micro-interactions that improve perceived performance — elegant, restrained, and always at 60 FPS.

philosophy.title: Reusable Systems
philosophy.description: Component libraries that accelerate whole teams. Build it once, build it right, and cut cross-team integration time in half.

philosophy.title: Collaboration & Ownership
philosophy.description: Cross-functional work with product, backend, QA, and stakeholders in Agile cycles — championing standards that keep five teams shipping without conflicts.

items.title: Gamatrain EdTech Platform
items.description: An innovative EdTech platform designed to empower learners and developers through a decentralised, open-source ecosystem. Leverages governance tokens to foster collaboration and rewards.

items.title: Pateh - Flight Booking Platform
items.description: A comprehensive online flight ticket booking system for domestic flights in Iran. Features real-time flight search, price comparison, secure payment integration, and 24/7 customer support.

items.title: Voice Assistant Bot
items.description: An intelligent voice assistant platform that provides the assistance you didn't know you needed. Features voice recognition, natural language processing, and automated task execution.

items.title: Red Crescent LMS
items.description: A comprehensive Learning Management System for Red Crescent training programmes. Features specialised courses in first aid, rescue operations, health & safety, and crisis management with certification.

items.title: AliExpress Clone
items.description: A full-featured e-commerce platform clone of AliExpress, built with Vue.js. Features product browsing, shopping cart, user authentication, and modern UI/UX design.

items.title: React Movie App
items.description: A modern movie discovery application built with React. Browse trending movies, search for your favourites, and explore detailed information about films with a sleek interface.

items.title: Python Slot Machine
items.description: A simple and fun slot machine game built with Python. Features random number generation, betting system, and colourful terminal interface. Have fun and test your luck!

items.title: Python Snake Game
items.description: A classic Snake game implementation using Python and the Tkinter GUI toolkit. Features smooth gameplay, score tracking, and collision detection with a retro gaming feel.
